feat(chat): Add "End Chat" functionality and confirmation dialog
This commit introduces a new feature allowing users to end a chat session. An "End Chat" button has been added to the chat screen, which, when tapped, presents a confirmation dialog to prevent accidental chat termination.
- **feat(chat):** - In `upper_view.dart`, a new "End Chat" `AppText` button has been added to the chat header. - Tapping the button displays a confirmation bottom sheet (`AppBottomSheet.large`) asking the user "Are you sure to end chat". - A new `alert.png` image is used in the confirmation dialog for visual emphasis. - Upon confirmation, a request is sent to the `ApiConstants.rejectAll` endpoint to terminate the chat. - After successfully ending the chat, the user is redirected to the home screen.
- **refactor(ui):** - In `upper_view.dart`, the layout has been changed from a `Stack` to a `Row` with `mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween` to better accommodate the new "End Chat" button alongside the existing report icon and timer/label. - The `AppText` widget has been enhanced to support `TextDecoration`.
- **i18n:** - Added new translation keys and their corresponding Arabic and English translations for "End Chat" (`end_chat`) and the confirmation message (`are_you_sure_to_end_chat`) in `lang.json`, `en.json`, and `ar.json`. - Updated `locale_keys.g.dart` to include the new translation strings.
- **build(ios):** - In `AppDelegate.swift`, removed Zego-related service setup code that is no longer needed in this file. - The project version in `project.pbxproj` has been incremented.
- **chore(dev):** - Added a new `gradleFix` command to the `Makefile` to help resolve Gradle lock file issues by stopping daemons and clearing lock files.
- **chore(assets):** - Added a new image `assets/images/alert.png`. - Regenerated `assets.dart` to include the new image asset.

refactor(packages): Correct package subscription and video call logic
This commit introduces several fixes and refactorings across the package subscription, video call, and chat functionalities to improve correctness and reliability.
- **fix(packages):** - In `subscribe_to_package.dart`, corrected the API request body for package subscriptions and renewals. - When renewing, it now correctly sends `user_package_id` with the old package ID. - The `package_id` parameter is now consistently sent with the actual package's ID (`package.packageId`), resolving a previous mapping issue. - In `package.dart`, the model has been updated to clarify the distinction between `id` (the user's specific package instance ID) and `packageId` (the general package template ID).
- **refactor(video-call):** - In `chat_screen.dart`, the video call feature has been refactored: - Logic now allows users to initiate a second video call request by tapping an icon if their free call (`free_used`) has been consumed. - The `onCallStarted` callback in `zego.dart` now correctly invokes `EndVideoCallCubit` when a Zego call is initiated, ensuring the backend call status is updated. A redundant log statement was removed. - The `EndVideoCallCubit` is now registered via dependency injection (`di.dart`, `setup_service_locators.dart`) and accessed as a singleton instance to ensure proper state management.
- **fix(chat):** - In `bottom_bar.dart`, the logic for counting sent images now correctly checks if the message is from the current user (`msg.sender.isFromMe`), preventing the recipient's images from being counted against the sender's two-image limit. - In `validators.dart`, chat message validation was improved to reject messages containing only whitespace.
- **chore(cleanup):** - Added a `log` statement in `edit_profile_image_widget.dart` for debugging image selection. - Ignored `.idea/workspace.xml` changes.

``` refactor(chat): Standardize API request paths and improve robustness
This commit refactors how API request paths are constructed for chat actions, standardizing them to prevent errors. It also improves the robustness of enum parsing and enhances the UI for displaying tips.
- **refactor(api):** - In `api_endpoints.dart`, a base path `matchRequestAnd` (`user-match-request/`) has been introduced. - All chat-related request constants (e.g., `userMoveToNextRequest`, `videoCallRequest`) are now relative paths. - In `user_status_action.dart`, `tips_action.dart`, `chat_screen.dart`, and `string_extension.dart`, API calls now prepend the `matchRequestAnd` base path, ensuring consistent and correct endpoint URLs.
- **fix(chat):** - In `string_extension.dart`, the enum parsers (`getCurrentStageAsStagesEnum`, `getMatchRequestAsEnum`, `getUserRequestStatusAsEnum`) have been made more robust by adding an `orElse` clause. This prevents crashes by returning a default enum value if an unknown string is received from the API. - In `chat_screen.dart`, a nullable check on the stage value (`stage!.value!`) has been corrected to prevent potential null pointer exceptions when determining the current stage.
- **fix(video-call):** - In `chat_screen.dart`, the logic for consuming a free video call has been corrected. The `endVideoCall` cubit is now triggered immediately after the user initiates a free video call request, ensuring the call status is updated correctly on the backend.
- **feat(ui):** - In `istikharah_reminder.dart`, the widget now uses the `Html` widget to render tips. This allows for rich text formatting (like newlines) in the reminder text, improving readability.
- **chore(ide):** - Ignored changes in `.idea/workspace.xml`.

``` refactor(core): Replace loading button and enhance permissions and connectivity
This commit replaces the deprecated `easy_loading_button` with `rounded_loading_button_plus`, creating a custom `LoadingButton` implementation for better control and consistency. It also enhances the permission handling logic for better reliability, especially on iOS, and introduces an optional internet connectivity interceptor in the base cubit.
- **refactor(core):** - Replaced `easy_loading_button` with `rounded_loading_button_plus` and added `connectivity_plus` to `pubspec.yaml`. - Created a new `CustomAnimatedButton` and a refactored `LoadingButton` to provide a consistent, app-wide loading button experience. - Replaced old `LoadingButton` usages with the new `AppLoadingButton` across various features (`auth`, `more`, `widgets`). - In `async_cubit.dart`, added an optional `enableInternetInterceptor` to `executeAsyncWithBaseModel`. When enabled, it uses `connectivity_plus` to listen for network changes and can re-trigger operations when the connection is restored. - The main internet interceptor widget in `app.dart` has been commented out in favor of the more granular cubit-level control.
- **refactor(permissions):** - Significantly improved the permission handling logic in `permission_handler/handler.dart`. - The handler now checks the permission status *before* requesting it, properly handling `granted`, `limited`, and `permanentlyDenied` states without re-requesting. - Added specific logic for iOS where a `denied` status is treated as permanently denied on subsequent checks. - Updated `helpers.dart` to pass more callbacks (`onDeniedForever`, `onLimited`) to the new handler, ensuring UI can react appropriately (e.g., by opening app settings).
- **fix(auth):** - In `image_widget.dart`, added a null check (`isNotNull`) to ensure an image is only processed if one was actually selected by the user.
- **chore(ios):** - Added `CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY`, `CODE_SIGN_STYLE`, and `PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER` settings to the iOS project file (`project.pbxproj`), likely for development build configuration.
- **chore(ide):** - Ignored changes in IDE configuration files (`.idea/workspace.xml`, `.idea/libraries/Dart_Packages.xml`, `.idea/caches/deviceStreaming.xml`, `.idea/libraries/Flutter_Plugins.xml`).
